purpose: Explicit source selection for a prospective curated-canada-v3. It preserves curated-canada-v2 and adds one hash-pinned, Manitoba-wide, historical crop-rotation semantic companion to the extended profile only. The companion supplies field-history context, not a field prediction, crop sequence, product, nutrient action, rate, procedure, or regulatory interpretation.

profiles.description: The v1 compact Canadian field-guidance core, unchanged to preserve its release boundary. Its geographic depth is intentionally uneven and all row-level historical, currency, and live-authority restrictions remain active.

The curated-canada-v2 extended profile plus four reviewed, context-only Manitoba historical crop-rotation field-history records. They do not predict an individual field, prescribe a crop sequence, authorize an input, or establish complete Manitoba rotation guidance.
